annotations.title: Find Swiss company in UID register

description: Searches the public Swiss UID register by company name (optionally with postal code or town) and returns up to 10 matches with UID, name, address and VAT registration status. Use it when the user knows a Swiss company's name but not its UID.

name.description: Company name or a distinctive part of it, at least 3 characters.
